name: Dev Container with Squid Egress Firewall
description: EXPERIMENTAL (0.x — expect breaking changes between releases). A dev container that can only reach an explicit allowlist of hosts. All traffic leaves through a Squid sidecar; the dev container itself has no route to the internet, so processes that ignore the proxy get no connectivity rather than unrestricted access. Intended for running coding agents under a reviewable network policy.
